list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden
note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry, from sources read on 20 Nov 2026. GTA 6 released 19 Nov 2026, so launch-era guides still disagree on a few items: each trophy carries a certainty status, and where sources disagree the guide shows both sides plus the safe action instead of inventing certainty.
sources_note: Full source list with read dates lives in app/data/sources.json. Short source names in each trophy match that file.

trophies.guide: The platinum has no task of its own: it pops the instant the other 54 trophies are earned. Use it as the finish line of the five-stage roadmap — story first, then free-roam grinds, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup. Tick trophies off in this tracker as you go and the platinum arrives on its own.
trophies.guide_short: The platinum. It pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — no separate task.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing through to the end. It is the first story mission, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss: follow the prompts, finish the sequence, and the trophy pops as the mission ends.
trophies.guide_short: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Unmissable — just play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 — 22 main missions according to PC Gamer, GameRant and Hudwire, who agree on the count. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude: that is the one spot in the whole game that may not come back.
trophies.guide_short: Finish all of Chapter 1's story missions. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first — see Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 — 11 main missions plus 2 optional ones, per GameRant and Hudwire. It pops at the end of the chapter's last mission. From the Coffee Break mission onward you can switch freely between Jason and Lucia, which is what the later meditation spots need.
trophies.guide_short: Finish all of Chapter 2's story missions. Unmissable — it pops at the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3 — 26 main missions, the longest chapter alongside Chapter 4, per PC Gamer, GameRant and Hudwire. It pops when the chapter's final mission, The Cartel Heist, ends — which also earns Break the Bank. Use the quiet gaps between missions to sample activities for Master of None.
trophies.guide_short: Finish all of Chapter 3's story missions. Unmissable — it pops at the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4 — 25 main missions, per PC Gamer, GameRant and Hudwire. It pops at the end of the chapter's last mission. By now most of the map and most activities are open, so start the longer grinds — stunts, shooting-range medals, card sets — between story missions.
trophies.guide_short: Finish all of Chapter 4's story missions. Unmissable — it pops at the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission in Chapter 5 — the shortest chapter, 7 main missions per PC Gamer, GameRant and Hudwire. This gold trophy marks the end of the story. Free roam stays open afterwards, so there is no need to rush the cleanup jobs before the finale; everything except one meditation stays available.
trophies.guide_short: Finish the final story mission. Gold, unmissable — free roam stays open afterwards for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It pops when the mission ends, and mission trophies cannot be missed — just finish the mission once. There is no mission replay in GTA 6, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (PowerPyx's advice: 15 manual slots plus one autosave) in case you ever need to rewind.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, the last mission of Chapter 3. It pops at the mission's end, and it also closes the chapter, so Vice City, Baby! pops with it. Heist missions run long: follow the objectives in order and do not leave the mission area early.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It pops when the mission ends. Like every mission trophy it is unmissable — the only requirement is finishing the mission once.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It pops when the mission ends. Play the story in order and this comes on its own — no side task is needed.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It pops when the mission ends. The airport setting is worth remembering for Catch Me If You Can, which is about leaving VCIA in an unscheduled way in free roam.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It pops when the mission ends. Expect heavy combat, so stock up on armour and ammo before starting rather than during the mission.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.dispute: PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer put the platinum at about 200 hours; Push Square says 300 hours or more. The majority says about 200, so the roadmap uses ~200 hours and flags the disagreement rather than hiding it.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion), which only becomes visible after the story — progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx, Push Square and Shacknews agree on the thresholds: 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 15 Bret's target decks, 200 of 277 vehicles, 50 of 66 weapons, 100 of 255 animals. It is closer to 60% of true completion, per PowerPyx — you do not need everything, only the checklist numbers. It pops the moment the checklist hits 100%.
trophies.guide_short: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist. Story plus the checklist numbers — 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 300 of 397 stunts.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the rest, as the game counts them. Do not grind them one by one at the start: stunts stack up naturally while you drive fast and play the story, so count them from the beginning and finish the remainder in free roam with a fast car on a ramp-heavy route. Note the gap to 100%: the checklist wants 300 of 397 stunts, so this trophy pops before A Long Road does. Check your running total on the in-game stats screen.
trophies.guide_short: Complete 250 stunts in total. They build up naturally while driving fast — finish the rest in free roam.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt (via Six Shore's summary). You only need to try each one, not win or finish it, so sample them as they open up during the story and tick each off in the counter here as you go.
trophies.guide_short: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sampling is enough — no win needed for any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the challenges weapon by weapon and repeat any challenge until it clears gold — silver or bronze does not count. Learn each challenge's target pattern before rushing the timer, and take the tighter late challenges slowly. All 42 golds are also needed for the 100% checklist.
trophies.guide_short: Gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Repeat any challenge until it clears gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race, so you need a win at every one, not 14 wins at the same spot. Learn each course's tight corners first at a slower pace, then race it for the win — a drone handles very differently from a car, so short practice runs pay off. The 100% checklist also wants all 42 drone time trials done.
trophies.guide_short: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. One win per location — learn each course first.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Replaying the same race does not count twice — you need 20 distinct race events won. Work through the race list across Leonida, picking races that suit the car you have, and use the counter here so you do not repeat one by mistake. The 100% checklist wants 30 unique races won, so keep going past 20.
trophies.guide_short: Win 20 different races. Replays of the same race do not count — win 20 distinct events.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are about reeling in the better catch: watch the line tension, reel steadily rather than yanking, and take the challenge when you have decent gear. One win against Cal is all it takes, and it also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.guide_short: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Reel steadily, watch the tension, and one win is enough.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish it, not just start it. Find an arcade machine, pick a game, and play it through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so choose the one you find easiest and finish that one. It also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.guide_short: Complete any one arcade game, start to finish. Pick the easiest machine and play it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is a chain of missions: keep taking his missions when they appear until the last one is offered, then finish it. Side-character finales stay available in free roam as long as you keep accepting that character's missions, so this cannot be missed by finishing the story.
trophies.guide_short: Complete Andy's final mission. Keep taking his missions until the last one appears, then finish it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Work through Kenton's mission strand in order until the last one appears, then finish it. If his missions stop appearing, check the map for his marker and advance the main story a little — strands often unlock with story progress. His treasure sets also feed the 100% checklist (5 of 7 needed).
trophies.guide_short: Complete Kenton's final mission. Work his strand in order until the last mission appears.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Work through Billy's mission strand in order until the last one appears, then finish it. Biker-style missions reward a good bike and a steady pace over rushing.
trophies.guide_short: Complete Billy's final mission. Work his strand in order until the last mission appears.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx is still confirming which stranger strands count toward the 8, and Six Shore notes only some side questlines qualify. No source has published a settled list yet.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as markers on the map — talk to the stranger, finish their whole chain, and count it. You need 8 full strands, not 8 single missions. Stranger strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so this silver is a separate block — start it early and keep following each stranger until their story ends.
trophies.guide_short: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands. Eight whole chains, not eight single missions.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.safe_action: Finish 9 or more stranger strands, including all five named side characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), so the count holds whichever strands end up qualifying.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Work through Randy's mission strand in order until the last one appears, then finish it. Keep accepting his missions as they show up and the finale will unlock.
trophies.guide_short: Complete Randy's final mission. Work his strand in order until the last mission appears.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Work through Tyrone's mission strand in order until the last one appears, then finish it. His missions are part of the stranger-style chains that also feed Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.guide_short: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Work his strand in order until the last mission appears.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx and GTABase both say it is unconfirmed whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required: it raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, and PowerPyx's author had 17 of 18 before the final meditation and 18 of 18 after it — so the final one may count double. KeenGamer and EGamers agree it is unconfirmed. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so this dispute does not affect A Long Road.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. There are 10 meditation places and 18 meditations: most places count twice, once with Jason and once with Lucia, once both characters are available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The last spot, Ascent on Mount Kalaga, only appears on the map after the others are done. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE PART: the first meditation is Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, in the morning after the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1 — talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony, choose Accept. It becomes unavailable after Chapter 1.
trophies.guide_short: Meditate at all 18 spots. MISSABLE: do the Chapter 1 balcony with Lucia after Down to Earth first — it does not return.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.safe_action: Meditate on the Chapter 1 balcony anyway — it costs minutes, and it protects the trophy if the spot turns out to be required. Make a manual save before leaving Chapter 1.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take Bret's hunting job, follow the trail or marker to the animal's area, and take it down cleanly — a scoped rifle and patience beat spraying. One unique animal is enough for the trophy, and Bret's 15 target decks are also needed for the 100% checklist, so keep taking his jobs.
trophies.guide_short: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Follow his job to the animal, then take it down cleanly.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets holding 480 cards in total, per PowerPyx — you only need 3 full sets for this silver, so focus on one set at a time rather than grabbing at random, and use the in-game collection screen to see which cards each set is still missing. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past 3.
trophies.guide_short: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Focus on one set at a time and check what each set still needs.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Build it into normal play: scan unfamiliar vehicles and locations with the WAiNK app whenever you pass somewhere new instead of saving it for a grind at the end. The counter is cumulative, so every location you log counts toward the 100 — and the 100% checklist wants the same 100 WAiNK locations.
trophies.guide_short: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Log new places as you travel — the count is cumulative, so start early.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total. Challenges cover many small tasks across the game, so this one fills up while you chase the other trophies — stunts, races, shooting and exploration all feed it. Check the challenges screen for the ones closest to done and finish those first. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 and save the hardest 10 for last.
trophies.guide_short: Complete 50 challenges. They fill up while chasing other trophies — finish the nearest ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Get the heat up together, then break line of sight, switch to a fast car and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner present is the requirement — the same escape alone does not count.
trophies.guide_short: With your partner, reach 4 stars, then lose the wanted level and escape. Partner must be present.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level. Plan a short route between three nearby shops, rob each in turn with your partner along, and keep the wanted level alive between them — if it drops to zero the chain breaks. A fast getaway car parked close to the third shop helps.
trophies.guide_short: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan three nearby shops.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Getting in or driving a new vehicle model counts it as discovered, so try a different car, bike or truck whenever you see one you have not driven. The count builds naturally across the story and free roam; use the vehicle list to spot which types you are still missing. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.guide_short: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive a new model whenever you see one — the count builds naturally.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Pick a busy fight rather than a lone enemy, and make sure you have enough ammo before you trigger it.
trophies.guide_short: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. Pick a grouped fight and chain the takedowns before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. In free roam, steal a Bottcher 020 double-decker jet parked at a boarding bridge at VCIA, gates E3 or E4 (per DamnModz), and fly it about a kilometre away from the airport. Expect a wanted level for the stunt, so have a fast exit planned for after you are airborne.
trophies.guide_short: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA airport. Steal a jet there and fly it away off-schedule.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.dispute: Early lists only said 'Rhino tanks' with no method. KeenGamer, Boosting Factory, DamnModz and TrueAchievements now agree on the method — steal a Rhino at Mile Zero Air Station and get in. Resolved in favour of that method.
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank at Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County and get in it — the trophy pops once you are driving it around the base, and firing the cannon for a few seconds helps if it does not pop at once (DamnModz, TrueAchievements). Tanks do not spawn on ordinary streets, so go to the base: approach the south-east entrance, get past the barricades and soldiers, and take an unlocked Rhino. Make a manual save first — your wanted level will get very high.
trophies.guide_short: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and drive it. Get in, drive around, fire the cannon if it does not pop.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take what you need and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — a clean, undetected run is the requirement.
trophies.guide_short: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go quiet, avoid cameras, and leave before any alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.dispute: Some early lists graded this bronze. The official PlayStation list grades it silver, and Exophase, PSNProfiles and GTABase agree. Resolved in favour of the official list: silver.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a planned job: get in, crack or open the vault, take the cash and get clear before the response arrives. You need five separate vault robberies, so space them out and keep a getaway vehicle ready. The 100% checklist wants 8 vaults hit, so keep robbing past 5.
trophies.guide_short: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Five separate jobs — keep a getaway vehicle ready.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it — blocking it or disabling it — take the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. One clean robbery and escape is all it takes.
trophies.guide_short: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the cash, then lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, walk or fly into every named area until the map counts it as visited. Work region by region and use the map's area list to find the ones you have not entered yet — the last few are usually small spots on the edges of the map.
trophies.guide_short: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Work region by region and check the map for unvisited spots.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. You need one per gang, so keep a list of which gangs you have already hit and target the remaining ones — use the counter here. Each operation is a defended spot, so scout it first, then rob it and get clear. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations cleared, so keep going past 9.
trophies.guide_short: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Keep a list — one per gang, no repeats needed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach, order or enjoy a cocktail there, and stay for the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — no combat, no timer. No source has pinned the exact trigger: PowerPyx lists it as not yet known and GTA Zone marks the exact trigger unconfirmed, so the guide gives the plain reading of the description and flags it rather than inventing steps.
trophies.guide_short: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet moment — right place, no combat needed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.safe_action: Order a cocktail at an Ocean Beach beachfront bar around sunset and stay for the view; if nothing pops, try another beachfront spot. Do not grind one guessed location.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — the plain reading is to drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. GTABase suggests crashing a car out through a showroom window, but no source has confirmed the exact trigger: PowerPyx lists it as not yet known and GTA Zone marks it unconfirmed. Pick a showroom, line up a fast car, and go through the front in one run. Expect a wanted level afterwards, so plan your exit.
trophies.guide_short: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in a car, through the glass, in classic style. Exact trigger unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.safe_action: Drive out through a showroom's front glass; if it does not pop, try a different showroom. Do not treat any single guessed method as certain.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.dispute: Two different methods are reported. Most guides say bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley; GTA Scoop says steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, and GameTrek lists a Hit Kingpin Bowling optional job in Chapter 2. No consensus yet.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there to its end. That is the method most guides give, and it also counts as one activity type for Master of None. The competing report — stealing 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling — is listed separately in the dispute note because the sources do not agree.
trophies.guide_short: Play bowling through at the Kolt & Associates alley. Disputed: another report says Kingpin Bowling valuables — do both.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.safe_action: Bowl a full game at Kolt & Associates AND take the Kingpin Bowling job if it is offered — covering both reported methods costs one extra session.

trophies.dispute: Some lists call this a story trophy with no method, and a few say it unlocks during the campaign. GTABase, KeenGamer, Boosting Factory and DamnModz agree it is maxing Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Resolved in favour of that majority.
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. After Coffee Break in Chapter 2 you can switch freely between them, so work out together and both gain progress — the Jason and Lucia menu shows each one's Strength. Train both to the top and the trophy pops.
trophies.guide_short: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Work out together after Coffee Break and both gain progress.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.dispute: GTABase, KeenGamer and Games.gg agree on 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. CryptoGames notes the number rests largely on one source family, so treat it as the best available figure, not gospel. All sources agree on the warning: the Irredeemable profile is permanent, per GTABase and PowerPyx.
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile — robberies, fights and other actions feed it naturally across a full playthrough, so there is no single mission to hunt. Let the count build while you chase the other trophies and check your Criminal Profile screen to watch it climb. Do not go on a rampage to force it: GTABase and PowerPyx both warn the Irredeemable profile is permanent, so check the Criminal Profile guide before pushing your profile hard.
trophies.guide_short: Choices made — 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It builds up across the whole game; let it come naturally.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.safe_action: Let it build naturally from robberies and fights; check your Criminal Profile, and stay away from Irredeemable — it is permanent.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the plain reading is to succeed at something on your second try after failing it once. No source has pinned the exact trigger: PowerPyx lists it as not yet known, KeenGamer calls the method unconfirmed, and one site's guess that it involves Payday Loans is only a guess. Do not grind a guessed method. It will most likely pop on a natural retry, so keep playing and it should come.
trophies.guide_short: Second time's the charm. Exact trigger unconfirmed — it will most likely pop on a natural retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.safe_action: Do not grind a guessed method. Keep playing; if a repeatable attempt fails, succeed at the very next one and watch for the pop.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's odd, unexplained moment. GTABase links it to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, but no source has confirmed which event or where. Explore the stranger corners of Leonida, especially at night and off the main roads, and this pops when you stumble into the right scene. It is a discovery trophy, so wandering pays off — but do not chase one specific guessed spot.
trophies.guide_short: Witness something strange. Exact trigger unconfirmed — explore Leonida's odd corners, especially at night.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.safe_action: Wander the odd corners of Leonida at night and off the main roads. No source has pinned the trigger, so do not chase a specific spot.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a person with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The description itself gives the method, but the exact trigger is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists it as not yet known and GTA Zone marks the exact trigger unconfirmed. Drive slowly past a pedestrian on a quiet street, swing the melee weapon from the car, and knock them down.
trophies.guide_short: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by from a moving vehicle. Exact trigger unconfirmed — slow pass, one clean swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.safe_action: Slow drive-by on a quiet street, one melee swing from the car. If it does not pop, retry — the exact trigger is unconfirmed.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to launder them, and the total builds up. Keep laundering after every big job instead of letting marked bills pile up, and this finishes during the story and cleanup. The same $250,000 is also needed for the 100% checklist.
trophies.guide_short: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Launder after every big job — it adds up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades all count, so this builds up naturally if you buy gear as you go. If you are short near the end, buy the most expensive useful items you still need rather than wasting money on things you will never use.
trophies.guide_short: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes and upgrades all count — it builds up naturally.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages appear for sale around Leonida — buy each one when you can afford it, and keep the money aside for the last few. Owning them also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.
trophies.guide_short: Buy all 8 garage properties. Save money for the last few — they also store your discovered vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you have discovered, open the app, and register each one. Any 10 distinct vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most and top the list up with new finds as you explore.
trophies.guide_short: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Any 10 distinct vehicles count — register as you find them.
trophies.name: On the Spot
